label: discovery-checks
invocation: async (page) => { const origin="http://127.0.0.1:4181", target="/debate/sharpton-hitchens-god-religion-morality-2007/", results=[],errors=[]; page.on("pageerror",e=>errors.push(e.message)); for(const route of ["/interlocutor/christopher-hitchens/","/","/search/?q=Sharpton","/topics/"]){await page.goto(origin+route);await page.locator("main h1").first().waitFor();await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");const count=await page.locator(`a[href="${target}"]`).count();if(!count)throw new Error("Missing debate link: "+route);results.push({route,debateLinks:count,noOverflow:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1)});}await page.goto(origin+"/rankings/");await page.locator("main h1").first().waitFor();await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");const ranked=await page.locator("a[href=\"/interlocutor/al-sharpton/\"]").count();if(!ranked)throw new Error("Missing Sharpton ranking link");const sitemap=await page.request.get(origin+"/sitemap.xml");const sitemapContainsDebate=(await sitemap.text()).includes(target);if(!sitemapContainsDebate||errors.length)throw new Error(JSON.stringify({sitemapContainsDebate,errors}));return {results,rankingProfileLinks:ranked,sitemapContainsDebate,runtimeErrors:errors}; }
